title: Analytics
subtitle: Objective metrics with clear formulas — no "overall life score".

formulas.tasks: How it is counted|Completed ÷ (completed + overdue open) due in the period. Cancelled tasks and tasks due in the future are left out.
formulas.habits: How it is counted|Completed scheduled days ÷ scheduled days. Rest days and pauses are excluded; today counts only once it is over.
formulas.focus: How it is counted|Time entries marked Focus or linked to focus blocks. Overlapping entries are never counted twice.
formulas.accuracy: How it is counted|How much of the planned time of past events is backed by time tracked for them or their tasks.

distribution.title: Where the time went
distribution.empty: No time entries in this period.

footer: Formula version {{version}}. Closed periods saved in weekly reviews never change retroactively.
